exceptions.reason: Reviewed against the official npm 12.1.0 and 12.2.0 bundles: the exact original index.js SHA-256 is checked and the native CachePolicy regression rejects unsafe max-stale/stale-while-revalidate reuse after patching while preserving normal reuse. Upstream 4.3.0 still has no fix. Scope is limited to this advisory, package, version and path through the next seven-day security-refresh window; retain the real package version and review again when a fix is published.
